mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, default_group, created_at FROM `groups` WHERE id = #{groupId}
SELECT id, user_id, name, default_group, created_at FROM `groups` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND default_group = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at, COUNT(gp.id) AS good_place_count FROM `groups` g LEFT JOIN good_places gp ON gp.group_id = g.id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at ORDER BY g.default_group DESC, g.created_at ASC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at, COUNT(gp.id) AS good_place_count FROM `groups` g LEFT JOIN good_places gp ON gp.group_id = g.id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.id = #{groupId} GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at
SELECT id, user_id, name, default_group, created_at FROM `groups` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at, u.id AS user_id, u.nickname, u.handle, u.profile_image, COUNT(gp.id) AS good_place_count FROM `groups` g JOIN `users` u ON g.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN good_places gp ON gp.group_id = g.id WHERE ( g.user_id = #{userId} OR g.user_id IN ( SELECT target_user_id FROM follows WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at, u.id, u.nickname, u.handle, u.profile_image HAVING COUNT(gp.id) > 0 ORDER BY g.default_group DESC, g.created_at ASC
